Mr Jones Watches · ref. 103-R6

A Perfectly Useless Afternoon

Art · 37–40mm · 5ATM · quartz

A playful and unconventional watch family that forgoes traditional hands, instead using rotating discs to depict a relaxing scene that indicates the time. Designed by Kristof Devos, its signature feature is a lounging figure whose leg points to the hour, with another floating element marking the minutes, serving as a reminder to enjoy the moment.

The story

The 'A Perfectly Useless Afternoon' series began in the summer of 2019 with a design by Belgian illustrator Kristof Devos, inspired by a quote from Lin Yutang about the value of leisure. The initial quartz model quickly gained a cult following for its creative time display. This success led to the introduction of companion pieces, 'A Perfectly Useless Morning' and 'A Perfectly Useless Evening', which explore different times of day with similar artistic concepts. In 2023, a larger mechanical version of the original 'Afternoon' was released, catering to watch enthusiasts who prefer automatic movements. A 'Remixed' version of the original quartz watch was also introduced, offering a more minimalist take on the design.
